# Privacy policy

DumpSock has no servers, no analytics, no account system, and no telemetry. There is nothing for us to collect because nothing is collected.

## What we collect

Nothing.

## What we share with third parties

Nothing.

## What we sell

Nothing.

## What you give us

Nothing.

## Cookies

We don't use cookies because we don't have a service that could.

## GDPR / CCPA / LGPD

Not applicable — there is no personal data processing happening on any system we operate.

## Children's privacy

Same as adults' privacy: there's nothing to collect.

## Source code

The application is open source at [github.com/code-hartle-tech/dumpsock](https://github.com/code-hartle-tech/dumpsock). You can audit the entire codebase to verify these claims. If you find a single network call we haven't disclosed in [Privacy features](./features/privacy), please report it to `contact@hartle.tech` and we'll fix it.

## Changes to this policy

If we ever add anything that requires real data collection (we have no current plans to), this policy will change and we'll publish the change with at least 30 days notice on this page and via GitHub Releases. Any data-collecting feature will be **opt-in** and **fully disclosed** in the feature itself, not buried in policy text.

## Contact

`contact@hartle.tech`
